verdict.rationale: Modal provides official Python, JS and Go SDKs that let users programmatically interact with the platform, which is its own documented programmatic interface. However, no public HTTP/OpenAPI spec was found (all OpenAPI probe paths returned 404), and the JS/Go SDKs cover only 'some' platform resources. missing for 10: documented public REST/HTTP API with an OpenAPI spec, full resource coverage across non-Python SDKs, independent hands-on corroboration of API-driven control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The [Modal](https://modal.com/) Python SDK allows you to deploy high-performance serverless applications and programmatically interact with the Modal platform.
The JS and Go SDKs allow you to use Modal Sandboxes, invoke deployed Modal Functions, and interact with some Modal platform resources.
